main_measure.name: mean forward 12-bar log excess return after top-decile |forecast| bars

statistic.name: t of the mean on non-overlapping 12-bar blocks

main_measure.threshold: confirm: negative with t <= -2 and negative in >= 2 coins; reject: positive with t >= +2; else inconclusive; needs >= 30 episodes per coin and >= 100 pooled

supporting_check.name: excess return falls steadily from zero-forecast group through |forecast| quintiles (Spearman rho), same sign in >= 2 coins

decided_by: The pooled t lies between -2 and +2.
reading: Top decile is the pooled 90th percentile of |forecast| over all bars of all coins and windows (non-zero only), excess is each bar's forward 12-bar log return minus its coin-window mean over all bars, sampled on the 0,12,24,... grid with the ordinary t of the mean; with only 2 coins in the record, 'at least 2 of 3 coins' is read as both coins, and 'fall steadily' as strictly decreasing pooled means over neutral then quintiles 1-5, with a negative per-coin Spearman slope in at least 2 coins.
